column1: # The Wiz trust ledger: the trusted base of lib/ (and the axiom-free examples).
# One line per source of trust: module<TAB>declaration<TAB>item.  `item` is the wording
# of `#print axioms` (`axiom X`, `native f := g` for implemented_by, `native T := mk/get`
# for a repr registration, `native_refl X.native✝`, `smt X.smt✝…`, `builtin k := n`), or
# `partial` for a partial definition (its body is compiled, not unfolded).
# `builtin inline` (a compiler hint) and `builtin int` (how values print) are not
# trust and are not listed. A new line fails the `native` group (and
# scripts/trust-ledger.sh): review it, then regenerate this file with
